ऋज् (for primitive रज्), i. 1, Ātm.
 1. † To go.
 2. † To stand or to be firm.
 3. † To gain.
 4. † To be strong.
 5. To live.
 --Ved. i. 4, Par., and Ātm.
 1. To stretch.
 2. To desire, to strive for.
 --Cf. रज् under ऋजु, ὀρέγω, ὀρέγνυμι, ὀριγνάομαι; Lat. regere, rectus; Goth. rakjan; A.S. reccan; Goth. raihts, etc.
